admission.justification: The regression prevents a repository shape or citation eligibility decision from aborting the check or hiding content drift.

applicability: Citation reads through the synchronous memory-quality source reader.
conditions: A path component is a symbolic link or Git cannot classify the path.
exclusions: Ordinary absent paths keep their distinct absent-path observation.
The result does not authorize following a symbolic link.
statement: Citations through links or into Git-unclassifiable paths return a named unavailable observation instead of aborting the synchronous check.
